title: services.services.create
description: Payload of commands/service_create.sql. `hub_id`, `new_id`, `current_user_id` and `now` are injected by the runtime (§2.5) and are NOT part of the payload — sending them is refused. A service is sold as one sale line with its VAT, so it cannot exist without knowing how it taxes: `tax_category_key` is REQUIRED here, at save time (services#33). Closed contract (services#9): pricing type is an enum, money and durations have floors, flags are 0/1, unknown keys are refused. Omitted optional fields resolve in the statement (caller → hub settings → module default), on purpose NOT as schema defaults: a schema default for `duration_minutes` would silently override the hub's `default_duration` setting (services#13).

name.description: Name of the service. NOT NULL in the column and with no fallback in the statement.

tax_category_key.description: Canonical fiscal category the service taxes by (ADR-0085), one of the `key` values of `taxes.categories.list`. `minLength` is not decoration: `required` alone accepts "", and "" is exactly no category.

slug.description: URL-safe key, unique per hub (`uq_*_hub_slug`): lowercase, no spaces. Empty/null = derived by the statement/handler.

category_id.description: Service category of THIS hub, or none. The statement checks the ownership and fails with `services.category_unavailable` if it belongs to another hub or is deleted (services#7).

pricing_type.description: Closed domain. `from` prices carry `min_price`/`max_price`; `free` sells at 0.

price.description: Minor units of the hub currency (ADR-0007/0123): 1500 = 15,00 € — never the typed-in major unit.

min_price.description: Lower bound of a `from`/`variable` price, in minor units. `min_price <= max_price` is enforced by the CHECK constraint (JSON Schema cannot compare two fields).

max_price.description: Upper bound of a `from`/`variable` price, in minor units.

duration_minutes.description: A service takes time: 0 or negative is not a duration. Omitted = the hub's `default_duration` setting (resolved by the statement, not here — a schema default would override the setting).

buffer_before.description: Minutes blocked before the service. Omitted = hub's `default_buffer_time`.

buffer_after.description: Minutes blocked after the service. Omitted = hub's `default_buffer_time`.

max_capacity.description: How many customers one slot serves; at least 1.
